verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron is a first-party Postgres module for scheduling recurring jobs with cron syntax, from every second to once a year. Jobs can be created via SQL or the Dashboard, run SQL, database functions, or HTTP calls such as Edge Functions, and job runs are monitored inside Postgres. Queues add durable background-task handling. Because jobs are created with SQL, an agent could plausibly set them up through the MCP execute_sql tool, but the docs never state this. missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent/MCP-driven job scheduling, multi-step workflow orchestration beyond single cron jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
